changes: New prepared-salsa adaptation: 250 g Salsa Verde replaces 400 g raw tomatillo; not an edible-yield conversion. Omit 3 g added salt, reduce lime from 35 to 20 ml and optional soy from 15 to 5 ml because the salsa is already salted/acidified/seasoned. Use 500 ml process water instead of 650. Retain all meat juice/fat, weigh drained beans, cook frozen coriander and explicitly thaw frozen avocado with all juice.
recipes.content_review: Tunt nötkött avger sitt eget spad i en grön tomatillobuljong, med krispigt fläsk och bönor. Uttrycklig såsanpassning, skild från tjock chili, rivet långkokt fläsk och kall köttsallad.
